What it means: Diagram elements link to an entry instead of carrying their own text
Velora example: Every lane Order Desk Clerk links to the same role entry

What it means: Changing the entry changes every linked element
Velora example: When SAP ECC is renamed SAP ECC (retiring Wave 1), all models show it

What it means: Each entry shows every diagram that uses it
Velora example: PriceBook is used in 9 models across 3 level 2 groups
